newsitem.title: PERU: Peru foreign investment up $43.39 mln in August.
newsitem.headline: Peru foreign investment up $43.39 mln in August.

text.p: Direct foreign investment in Peru rose $43.39 million in August to a total registered stock of $5.722 billion, the government's National Commission of Foreign Investment and Tecnology (CONITE) said Friday.
The CONITE, which could not give comparative figures for August 1995, started registering foreign investment in 1988.
The organization added that total foreign investment in shares traded on the Lima Stock Exchange - which is monitored separately - was $3.11 billion at the end of July.
Foreign capital accounted for $3.17 billion of trade, or 65 percent of the total, on the bolsa between January and August of this year.
